import json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import execute_provider as P, execution_spec as S
NL = chr(10)
R = pathlib.Path.cwd()
T = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()).resolve()
root, bindir, M = T / 'repo', T / 'bin', 'docs/missions/fx'
(root / 'scripts').mkdir(parents=True)
bindir.mkdir()
for n in ('execution_spec.py', 'execution_receipt.py', 'execution_runner.py', 'execute_provider.py', 'observe_output.py', 'model_id.py', 'run_id.py', 'fleet_state.py', 'dispatch_policy.py', 'harness_registry.py', 'ledger.py', 'spawn-brain.sh', 'brain_prompt.py'):
    shutil.copy2(R / 'scripts' / n, root / 'scripts' / n)
shutil.copy2(R / 'harness-registry.json', root / 'harness-registry.json')
(root / M / 'tasks').mkdir(parents=True)
(root / M / 'GOAL.md').write_text(NL.join(['---', 'status: in-progress', '---', '# Goal', '']))
(root / M / 'features.json').write_text(json.dumps({'goal': 'fx', 'features': []}) + NL)
(root / '.gitignore').write_text('.tasks/' + NL)
CAPS = {'claude': ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh', 'max'], 'codex': ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh']}
def fleet(provider, model, effort):
    seat = {'provider': provider, 'model': model, 'family': {'claude': 'haiku', 'codex': 'luna'}[provider], 'effort': effort, 'speed': 'unknown', 'health': 'healthy', 'source': 'alias' if provider == 'claude' else 'observed', 'capabilities': {'efforts': CAPS[provider], 'speeds': ['unknown']}}
    doc = {'schema_version': 1, 'mission': {'path': M}, 'inventory': {'sha256': '0' * 64, 'probed_at': '2026-08-21T00:00:00Z'}, 'approval': {'status': 'approved', 'approved_by': 'human', 'approved_at': '2026-08-21T00:00:00Z'}, 'seats': {'brain': seat}}
    (root / M / 'fleet.json').write_text(json.dumps(doc, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) + NL)
def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'gc.auto=0', '-c', 'maintenance.auto=false', '-c', 'user.email=t@example.invalid', '-c', 'user.name=t', *a], cwd=root, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
fleet('claude', 'plan-model', 'high')
git('init', '-q')
git('add', '.')
git('commit', '-qm', 'fixture')
FIX = R / 'tests/fixtures/observe/claude-subagent.jsonl'
PROBE = T / 'probe.json'
stub = NL.join(['#!/usr/bin/env python3', 'import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys', 'g = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", *a], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout', 'pathlib.Path(%r).write_text(json.dumps({"cwd": os.getcwd(), "argv": sys.argv[1:], "remotes": g("remote"), "head": g("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()}))' % str(PROBE), 'pathlib.Path("scratch-write.txt").write_text("x")', 'p = os.environ.get("PLAN_LIVE_WRITE")', 'p and pathlib.Path(p).write_text("x")', 'sys.stdout.buffer.write(pathlib.Path(%r).read_bytes())' % str(FIX), ''])
for name in ('claude', 'codex'):
    (bindir / name).write_text(stub)
    (bindir / name).chmod(0o755)
REQ = T / 'request.md'
TEXT = 'Write tasks/T-900.md for REQUEST-MARKER-7.'
REQ.write_text(TEXT + NL)
env = dict(os.environ, PATH=str(bindir) + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'], PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', SPAWN_BRAIN_TIMEOUT_SECS='0')
def spawn(*a):
    return subprocess.run(['bash', 'scripts/spawn-brain.sh', M, *a], cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
r = spawn('plan', '--request', str(REQ))
assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr + r.stdout
specs = sorted((root / '.tasks/specs').glob('*.json'))
assert len(specs) == 1, specs
spec = json.loads(specs[0].read_text())
rid = spec['run_id']
assert r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] == 'run_id=' + rid, r.stdout[-300:]
assert {k: spec[k] for k in ('role', 'work_unit', 'provider', 'model', 'effort', 'feature', 'repo')} == {'role': 'brain', 'work_unit': 'plan', 'provider': 'claude', 'model': 'plan-model', 'effort': 'high', 'feature': None, 'repo': str(root)}, spec
assert spec['provider_contract_version'] == S.CURRENT_PROVIDER_CONTRACT == 9, 'plan must reuse the current brain contract'
head, sep, req = spec['prompt'].partition(NL + '## Request' + NL)
assert head.startswith('You are the mission BRAIN for docs/missions/fx. Role: planning.') and '1000000 tokens' in head and '## Acceptance checks' in head, head[:200]
assert sep and req.strip() == TEXT, spec['prompt'][-300:]
probe = json.loads(PROBE.read_text())
argv = P.provider_contract(spec)[0]
assert probe['argv'] == argv[1:], probe['argv']
cwd = pathlib.Path(probe['cwd'])
assert cwd != root and root not in cwd.parents and not cwd.exists(), cwd
assert probe['remotes'] == '' and probe['head'] == spec['base_commit'], probe
assert not (root / 'scratch-write.txt').exists() and git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all') == ''
rc = json.loads((root / '.tasks/receipts' / (rid + '.json')).read_text())
assert (rc['outcome'], rc['workspace_changed'], rc['scope']['result']) == ('completed', False, 'pass'), rc
assert rc['resolved_configuration']['argv_sha256'] == P.argv_sha256(argv), rc['resolved_configuration']
row = json.loads((root / '.tasks/ledger' / (rid + '.json')).read_text())
assert (row['run_id'], row['task']) == (rid, 'plan') and row['subagents']['calls'] == {'value': 2, 'source': 'observed'}, row
log = (root / '.tasks/logs' / (rid + '.log')).read_bytes()
assert ('clone=' + str(cwd)).encode() in log, 'clone path not recorded in the log'
assert FIX.read_bytes() in log, 'provider output not kept in the log'
env['PLAN_LIVE_WRITE'] = str(root / M / 'tasks/T-901.md')
x = spawn('plan', '--request', str(REQ))
del env['PLAN_LIVE_WRITE']
assert x.returncode != 0 and 'plan run changed the live tree' in x.stderr, (x.returncode, x.stderr[-500:])
(root / M / 'tasks/T-901.md').unlink()
def refused(args, msg=None):
    n = len(list((root / '.tasks/specs').glob('*.json')))
    x = spawn(*args)
    assert x.returncode != 0, (args, x.stdout)
    assert len(list((root / '.tasks/specs').glob('*.json'))) == n, args
    assert msg is None or msg in x.stderr, (args, x.stderr)
refused(['plan'])
refused(['plan', '--request', str(T / 'missing.md')])
refused(['review', '--request', str(REQ)])
fleet('claude', 'plan-model', 'medium')
git('commit', '-qam', 'medium')
refused(['plan', '--request', str(REQ)], 'planning runs need effort high; got medium')
fleet('codex', 'plan-codex', 'high')
git('commit', '-qam', 'codex')
refused(['plan', '--request', str(REQ)])
shutil.rmtree(T)
print('ok')
